sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Harshad Bahrani - Advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Vikram Pippal - Public Prosecutor for the respond  ORDER
This revision has been filed without surrender of the petitioner.
On the last date i.e. on 23.11.2023 the petitioner was directed to surrender before the concerned trial Court and thereafter pray for grant of suspension of sentence.
The petitioner was also directed to file copy of relevant order-sheets of the trial Court with regard to his surrender.
More than two years has lapsed thereafter, but neither the petitioner has surrendered before the trial Court nor filed any document.

2.The petitioner has been convicted & sentenced by the trial Court under Section 7(ii) read with Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 with one year RI and fine of Rs.1,000/-.
The appellate Court though maintained the conviction, however, reduced the sentence from one year to six months RI.

3 . In view of Rule 48 of Chapter X of the High Court of Madhya NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:7494 2 CRR-5288-2023 Pradesh Rules, 2008, no exemption from surrender can be granted.

entities.text: High Court of Madhya Pradesh Rules, 2008
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: A memorandum of appeal or revision petition against conviction, except in cases where the sentence has been suspended by the Court below, shall contain a declaration to the effect that the convicted person is in custody or has surrendered after the conviction."
